album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar III

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on A3 and dwells most on A in Chaharmezrab. Nahib (1:00.7) introduces D, centred on A. The line peaks at E4 (348.6 Hz) at 1:44.5. It closes on the tonic (A3 → A3 → A3 → A2 → A2 → A2).
